output.answer: JPMorgan Chase's latest annual report is the 2025 Annual Report (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025), titled "Life, Liberty and the Pursuit of Happiness". You can find it on the company's investor relations site at jpmorganchase.com/ir/annual-report/2025, which also hosts Jamie Dimon's Chairman and CEO letter to shareholders; the full PDF is at jpmorganchase.com/content/dam/jpmc/jpmorgan-chase-and-co/investor-relations/documents/annualreport-2025.pdf. The same report is also on file with the SEC as an annual report to security holders (Form ARS), and the companion Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 was filed with the SEC on February 13, 2026 (accession no. 0001628280-26-008131), readable at sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000162828026008131/jpm-20251231.htm.
caveats: The full annual report PDF (annualreport-2025.pdf) is a very large document; if the direct link is slow, use the annual report landing page (jpmorganchase.com/ir/annual-report/2025) or the SEC-hosted copy.

"Annual report" can mean either the glossy shareholder report (with CEO letters) or the Form 10-K filed with the SEC; both are for fiscal year 2025 and both URLs are given above. Printed copies can be requested from Investor Relations (JPMCinvestorrelations@jpmchase.com, 212-270-2479).
